excluded.justification: FRIDAY_ROLL is date(2026-06-12), which is in NT8_ROLL_DATES and weekday()==4; both AND conjuncts are True, so AND vs OR is observationally identical on these constants.
previous_session is assigned at the end of every loop iteration, so `index > 0` already implies `previous_session is not None`; AND vs OR is identical.
floors_for() calls spec_for() first; every supported root is in CATALOG_DEFAULT_GEOMETRY, so pair is never None and the GeometryRefused raise is unreachable.

require_friday_roll() only runs after both friday flags are True on the current calendar; `not present or not is_friday` and `not present and not is_friday` are both False, so the raise never fires either way.
band_for() calls spec_for() first; unknown roots raise ContractError (a ValueError) before the trailing `raise ValueError`, so that raise is unreachable.
seal_holdout() builds train/holdout via access_bars(), which already enforces train[-1] < pin <= holdout[0]; the leak OR is unreachable given that split.
Same as boolop#10: the leak raise cannot fire because access_bars already returned a correct split, so deleting it is observationally identical.
structural_decay returns True for n<6 before spearman_rho; spearman_rho is finite for every n>=6 path because ranks_x is 1..n, so `not math.isfinite(rho)` is dead.
A 1-bar tape has first==last, so `start <= first or start >= last` always holds and the later span raise still fail-closes; the len<2 raise is redundant.
